# PriceUtils
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/price-utils/contracts/Utils.sol)

**Title:**
PriceUtils

**Author:**
Roberto Cano <robercano>

Utility library to manage prices in Solidity. The prices use the convention of base and quote assets,
where the price is expressed as how much quote asset is needed to buy one unit of the base asset.
In this sense a typical listed price of ETH/USD = 2000 means that 2000 USD (quote) are needed to buy 1 ETH
(base).
This is contrary to the mathematical convention of price = base/quote, but it is more aligned with how prices are
typically represented in financial markets.
An example of this is a price of ETH/USD = 2000, which means that the price is 2000 USD per ETH, which would be
represented
mathematically as 1/2000 = 0.0005 ETH per USD.


## Functions
### invert

Inverts a given Price type, swapping base and quote amounts and decimals

Used to convert from base/quote to quote/base representation


```solidity
function invert(Price memory price) internal pure returns (Price memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`price`|`Price`|The Price type to invert|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`Price`|The inverted Price type|


### quote

Given an amount of quote asset it calculates how much amount of the base
asset will be received at the given price rate


```solidity
function quote(Price memory price, uint256 amount) internal pure returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`price`|`Price`|The price rate of base/quote|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of quote asset to convert, as a uint256|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount of base asset that will be received|


### mul

Multiplies an amount by a price, effectively quoting the amount from quote asset to base asset

This is a convenience function that calls .quote() with the parameters reversed so that it
can be chained:
uint256 baseAmount = priceA.quote(amountA).mul(priceB);


```solidity
function mul(uint256 amount, Price memory price) internal pure returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of quote asset to convert, as a uint256|
|`price`|`Price`|The price rate of base/quote|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount of base asset that will be received|


### div

Divides an amount by a price, effectively quoting the amount from base asset to
quote asset

This is a convenience function that calls .invert().quote() with the parameters reversed
so that it can be chained:
uint256 quoteAmount = priceA.invert().quote(amountA).div(priceB);


```solidity
function div(uint256 amount, Price memory price) internal pure returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of base asset to convert, as a uint256|
|`price`|`Price`|The price rate of base/quote|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount of quote asset that will be received|
